review_type: independent AI review of the enhanced non-official research version
scope: planner.py enhanced defaults and terminal state
coverage.py contracted Q3 ring and Q4 lattice

resolved_findings.issue: Development comparison inherited enhanced default and duplicated the contracted ring
resolved_findings.resolution: develop_anchors.py now explicitly constructs strategy='integrated' for the legacy comparison; ring_radius is passed through the constructor

resolved_findings.issue: Terminal metadata was not connected to accepted observations
resolved_findings.resolution: accepted responses update terminal reason, channel certificates and complete/incomplete result; no /exit is sent after virtual or ambiguous termination

resolved_findings.issue: Previously measured no_signal locations could be queried again
resolved_findings.resolution: all accepted per-channel measure coordinates are retained and optional probes use exact-coordinate deduplication only

resolved_findings.issue: Static two-opt and interval adaptive probe candidates lacked a valid default benefit
resolved_findings.resolution: both retained as negative controls; rolling remaining-anchor route and Q3 ring contraction are evaluated on separated held-out seeds

resolved_findings.issue: Original finite-time bound did not justify cross-source task entry and reflection recovery
resolved_findings.resolution: bound_proof.tex and verify_geometry.py now use last-positive-station half-scaling, cross-source access, 216-cell cover, explicit action counts and 231152-second arithmetic bound

limitations: All simulator evidence is local synthetic, not official.
No contestant manual review has been performed.
Enhanced finite bound excludes optional adaptive probes and arbitrary network delay.
Rolling route and contracted ring improve declared synthetic held-out means but are not globally time-optimal.
verdict: Enhanced policy is technically coherent under declared assumptions and better on the held-out synthetic comparison; retain conservative claims and do not substitute for official tests or human review.
